name: ff_counter
variant_note: HOOKS=both, the default and the variant meant for Flash 1: one hook word in each 10 ms raster, so the counter runs whichever task set is live (re/findings/scheduler.md sections 8, 8.1 and 11.8). The set-A word 0x432940 is in the on-chip flash and carries "onchip_edit": true. The other variant is patch.external.json (`make HOOKS=external`), which hooks 0x12067C alone and is the pre-F1 patch byte for byte.
description: Flash 1: increment a u32 counter, record which task set called (1 = set A, 2 = set B, 3 = both) and write an alive pattern in the patch RAM block, once per 10 ms raster activation. No stock RAM, no calibration, no behaviour change.
ram_status_note: VERIFIED-STATIC (brief C2, issue #23, 2026-09-16): no instruction in the image references any byte of 0x7FF770-0x7FFFEB (re/findings/ram.md section 8.1); the block lies above the task stack 0x7FF3C0-0x7FF76F, outside the KWP programming copy 0x804800-0x808687 and outside the protected window. It is NOT filled at cold start, hence the ff_alive marker. Dynamic confirmation (RequestUpload snapshots across key cycles, the runtime half of #23) is pending: do not flash before it is done. Adopted at integration on 2026-09-16, replacing the placeholder 0x807F00 that C2 showed to be inside the programming copy.

hooks.why: task_100ms_int (0x4328E4, id 19), task set A's 10 ms raster: bl nop_leaf_bd9e4 -> ff_counter_hook_a trampoline, which tail-branches back to 0x0BD9E4 (re/findings/scheduler.md section 8.1). ON-CHIP FLASH 0x404000-0x47FFFF.
task_100ms (0x1205A0, TCB 23), task set B's 10 ms raster: bl clr_ram_7FE889_800E18 -> ff_counter_hook_b trampoline, which tail-branches back to 0x11F02C (re/findings/scheduler.md section 8)
